thread:
Rina (PM): kick-off: need a multi-tier rollout for priority-routing that balances sales opt-ins and safety. propose: shadow -> escorted tenants -> small A/B -> regional GA. quick thoughts? :clipboard:
Sam (SRE): +1. require per-tenant circuit-breaker, token-budget guard, and a global kill-switch. safety gates: p95 latency delta > 40ms for 10m OR error > 0.7% for 5m -> auto-fallback.
Vik (Backend): agree. plan flags at scopes: global, tenant, experiment. will add escort metadata for warm windows. sample escort yaml:
```
escorts:
  - tenant: t-801
    window: "02:00-04:00 UTC"
    warm_qps: 15
    token_budget_min: 8000
    fallback: baseline-v3
```
Rina (PM): sales wants clear opt-out guarantees and a surgical re-enable SLA (2-4h). can we support that operationally?
Jonah (Sales): yes customers will ask. include an "enterprise escort" add-on for fast re-enable and extra monitoring. I'll prepare comms + opt-in list.
Sam (SRE): re-enable runbook: ticket -> on-call approve -> staged re-enable (1 tenant, 5m ramp) -> monitor 30m -> escalate if issues. require two approvers for >10k QPS tenants. ops-bot should annotate audit trail.
ops-bot: rule added: "escort-safety". trigger: p95_delta>40ms 10m OR errors>0.7% 5m. action: set flag tenant_priority=false for affected tenants, open incident, ping @Sam (SRE).
Vik (Backend): quick rollback curl for runbook:
```
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/flags/tenant_priority \\  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \\  -d '{"tenant":"t-801","enabled":false}'
```
Rina (PM): GA acceptance (draft): 1) autopilot fallback wired and tested in staging, 2) per-tenant telemetry (p50/p95, errors, tokens/sec, fallback count), 3) opt-in form + customer comms, 4) runbook + surgical re-enable exercised, 5) A/B results show <=0.5% error delta.
Sam (SRE): add a cost-safety hook to pause experiments if projected extra token cost > $4k/day for tenant-group.
Vik (Backend): will land flags PR today with sample configs and rollback snippet.
Rina (PM): action items: Vik -> PR + examples (today), Sam -> ops-bot rules + dashboards (EOD), Jonah -> comms + opt-in list (tomorrow). target: start escorted tenants next Thurs during warm window. thanks everyone :rocket:
